name: Pinball
description: Classic pinball, one machine for everyone in the space: whoever plays first plays, the rest watch, high scores are shared. Quest: pinch the plunger knob and pull it back, rest a hand by a red side button and curl your fingers in to flip (or poke the button) (controllers: triggers flip). Pinch-hold anywhere else to move it. Phone: tap the left or right half of the screen; hold and let go to launch.

gestures.name: Pinball
gestures.how: Pinch the knob and pull; curl fingers by a button to flip
gestures.more: Pinch the plunger knob, pull it toward you, and let go to launch. To flip, rest a hand by a red side button like at a real machine and curl your fingers in; straighten them to let go. Poking the button works too. Holding anywhere else moves the machine as usual. Controllers: the triggers flip.
